_comment: GLM-5.3 Flash prefill+decode time-attribution. Source: TIMEIT run 382001 (shipping default: warm-compiled router + batched chunked KDA), real fp8 weights, 8-layer proxy, GNR gnrap 256 threads, 256-tok prefill + 8 decode, batch 1. ONLY the NON-overlapping decoder-layer leaves (attn.kda, attn.mla, moe, dense.mlp, mhc.hc_post) are listed — the raw dump also has nested sub-splits (kda.qkvbfg/conv/recur, moe.topk/expert_apply) and cross-cutting linear timers (dense.bf16/fp8_linear) that OVERLAP these leaves and must not be summed. layer.total - sum(leaves) = framework glue = the 'other/unattributed' slice.
precision: fp8 e4m3 block W8A16, bf16 compute
